news.title: Vagus nerve stimulation slows growth and spread of pancreatic cancer
paras: Pancreatic cancer is hard to treat. In mice, a tiny device sent gentle electrical signals along the vagus nerve, a body pathway from the brain to organs. The signals slowed the cancer’s growth and spread. They also helped cancer-fighting cells enter tumours, so a medicine that helps those cells attack cancer worked better.

The device wrapped around the food pipe and was switched on from outside the body. Researchers tested it in mice, not people, so we don’t know if it will help patients. Pancreatic cancer is often deadly, so finding treatments that work could matter greatly.

news.title: Intel faced a choice: Give Trump 10% or face the consequences
paras: Corporate capitalism Intel faced a choice: Give Trump 10% or face the consequences Intel faced pressure to surrender a 10% stake to unlock billions in promised grants. “The President is expecting to announce a deal on these terms on Friday.” Shapiro acknowledged that “the Board could choose not to accept the offer,” according to a summary of his remarks prepared for Intel’s directors.

But the Trump administration official “noted that rejection will have consequences that [Shapiro] cannot predict.” Days later, the board gave the administration what it wanted . “It is my Great Honor to report that the United States of America now fully owns and controls 10% of INTEL,” Donald Trump posted to his social platform .

paras: David Ferrer is wary of the threat that Great Britain will pose to his Spanish team ahead of their Davis Cup semi-final. sport.title: Jakub Mensik’s 2026 Season Recap: Another Step Towards the Elite
paras: The Czech began the season with an early title in Auckland, reached his first Grand Slam semifinal at Roland Garros and achieved a career-high ranking of World No. Although consistency at the biggest tournaments remained a work in progress, his performances against established names demonstrated that he is increasingly capable of competing with the best.

Mensik made an excellent start to the season by capturing the Auckland title. He defeated Sebastian Baez 6-3 7-6 in the final, saving three consecutive set points in the second-set tiebreak to secure his second ATP Tour singles title.

sport.title: Carlos Alcaraz is Chasing a Feat Even the Big Three Never Achieved
paras: Following his ATP Finals title in Turin , the Spaniard has arrived in Bologna with the ambition of adding another major achievement to his remarkable season: winning both the ATP Finals and the Davis Cup in the same calendar year. The 23-year-old defeated Alexander Zverev in Sunday’s ATP Finals Championship match, completing an impressive run of titles in Vienna, Paris and Turin.

Now, he turns his attention to representing Spain at the Davis Cup Final 8, where the team will face Austria in Thursday’s quarterfinal. The achievement Alcaraz is chasing is particularly significant because even Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, and Novak Djokovic failed to win both competitions in the same season.

sport.title: November 27, 2011: The day Roger Federer won a then-record sixth ATP Finals title
paras: Every day, Tennis Majors takes you back to one of the biggest moments in tennis history. On November 27, 2011, Roger Federer and Jo-Wilfried Tsonga clashed for the eighth time in the season

On this day, November 27 in 2011, Roger Federer defeated Jo-Wilfried Tsonga (6-3, 6-7, 6-3) to claim a record sixth crown in the ATP Finals in London. After he finished 1998 as world No 1 in juniors, Federer performed well in his first professional matches: in his five first main tour appearances in 1998-1999, he reached the quarter-finals three times, in Toulouse, Marseille and Rotterdam.
